stepTitle: Cristina wants to extract only rows with phone numbers that begin with $$510$$ (Berkeley's area code). Which of the following lines of code successfully returns the DataFrame of interest? Select all that apply.
stepBody:
Cristina reformats the information into a DataFrame called dishes. All entries in dishes are of the str datatype. The first $$5$$ rows of dishes are below:
name | dish | servings | course | phone number
Cristina | Carrot Cake Muffins | $$24$$ | D | $$510-555-5555$$
Ben | Pesto Pasta | $$15$$ | M | $$510-777-7777$$
Ella | greek salad | $$15$$ | S | $$415-555-5555$$
Sara | chips and guac | $$23$$ | A | $$949-555-5555$$
Rohan | Chicken | $$18$$ | M | $$415-111-1111$$
